sections.title: Positioning
sections.summary: Wix presents itself as the leading website builder, now led by an AI builder called Wix Harmony, and as a business platform with solutions for stores, bookings, courses and events.
keyPoints: Homepage: 'Create your future on the leading website builder', with 'Start for free. No credit card required.'
Scale is the proof: 300M+ sites built on Wix and 90K+ sites created daily.
Solutions listed on the home page include eCommerce, scheduling, lead management, portfolios, online courses and events; a separate Enterprise page targets multi-site organizations.

sections.title: Products and offerings
sections.summary: A website builder with a wide set of business tools around it, plus a services marketplace and an enterprise product.

rows: Wix Harmony
AI website builder for creating a site from a prompt
Online store and payments
Accept payments online, in person and on the go; competitive processing fees and an integrated payment dashboard
Wix POS
Omnichannel point of sale with synced inventory; available in the US, Canada and UK
Marketing and analytics
Email marketing, website analytics and marketing suites by plan
Domains and business email
Custom domains and business email with built-in AI
Marketplace and App Market
Hire experts, buy Wix Studio templates and add apps
Wix Studio and Enterprise
Pro editor and multi-site management for organizations

sections.title: Pricing
sections.summary: A free plan and five paid ones, shown as yearly prices paid in full. The pricing page lists the most expensive plan first.
keyPoints: 'Create your site for free and choose a plan when you're ready.' A 14-day money-back guarantee sits at the top of the page.
Displayed prices are for yearly subscriptions paid in full at purchase, and exclude taxes.
Every paid plan includes a free domain for 1 year; storage grows from 2 GB to unlimited.
Business is tagged recommended; only the top plan adds an advanced developer platform.

rows: Free
Hosting, drag-and-drop editor, no-code design features, 1000s of templates
Light
2 GB storage, light marketing suite, 2 collaborators
Core
50 GB storage, basic marketing suite, accept payments, basic ecommerce, scheduling, 5 collaborators
Business (recommended)
100 GB storage, standard marketing suite, standard ecommerce, 10 collaborators
Business Elite
Unlimited storage, advanced marketing suite, advanced ecommerce, advanced developer platform, 100 collaborators

gaps: Monthly-billing prices were not captured as text.

sections.title: Merchandising
sections.summary: An anchored ladder: a free plan, a recommended mid-tier plan and, on the page itself, the most expensive plan displayed first. Commerce depth scales across the plans, and merchants get broad selling tools.
keyPoints: The pricing page shows Business Elite at the left and Free at the right, so the highest price is the first one read.
A money-back guarantee and 'no credit card required' remove risk; 'Business' carries the recommended tag.
Commerce is tiered: basic, standard and advanced ecommerce, and basic to advanced marketing suites.
Experts and templates are sold through a marketplace, and apps through an App Market.
For merchants: scheduling and services, payments, POS with synced inventory, business email and analytics.

sections.title: Technical platform
sections.summary: A mix of no-code products and a developer-oriented layer: an advanced developer platform on the top plan, Wix Studio, an App Market and a newly announced AI-native editor.
keyPoints: The top plan lists an 'advanced developer platform'.
The newsroom announces Studio Two, described as a truly open, AI-native visual editor for professional web creation.
A marketplace lets developers sell services and templates and turn skills into revenue.
gaps: API documentation and app-development guides were not surveyed.

sections.title: Design
sections.summary: Light and airy: a large rounded headline, soft gradients, a blue accent and pill buttons. The home page is extremely long and uses many videos.
keyPoints: One display family (Madefor) runs through the home page, pricing and sign-up, with blue (#166aea) and 42px button corners.
The home page is 17,325px tall with 19 videos; pricing is 7,613px.
The home hero is a centered headline on a pale yellow gradient above a product mockup.
The pricing page sits inside a pale blue panel with a banner for the guarantee and five plan cards.
For merchants: an AI website builder, 2,000+ templates and drag-and-drop and no-code design features.
gaps: Mobile and dark mode were not assessed.

sections.title: Company presentation
sections.summary: A scale story with AI as the current chapter, and a newsroom that mixes results, product launches and a startup accelerator.
keyPoints: Newsroom items include third-quarter 2026 results and the Studio Two launch, plus an accelerator for Base44.
Home claims 300M+ sites and 90K+ new sites a day.
The enterprise page says Wix is trusted by hundreds of millions of users worldwide.
gaps: No leadership information in the surveyed pages.

signupPath: 'Start for free' on the homepage opens users.wix.com/signin/signup, a page headed 'Sign up' with 'Continue with Google', 'Continue with Facebook' and 'Continue with Apple', or an email box and 'Continue with Email'. A line says that signing up means agreeing to the Terms of Use and acknowledging the Privacy Policy, with a reCAPTCHA notice. Only an email is asked on this page; what follows was not reached. Nothing was entered.

jtbd_fit.evidence: Homepage lists solutions by job: store, scheduling, leads, portfolio, courses, events.

capability_visible.evidence: Feature pages, templates and an AI builder preview show a lot; the editor is behind signup.

pricing_transparency.evidence: All six plans have prices and included features; yearly billing and taxes are stated; monthly prices not captured.

product_breadth.evidence: Builder, payments, POS, marketing, email, domains and marketplace are each explained.

platform_depth.evidence: An App Market, an advanced developer platform and Studio exist, but no developer docs were surveyed.

time_to_value.evidence: Capture stops before the product; first-value time was not observed.

friction.evidence: One click to a page offering Google, Facebook, Apple or email.

trust.evidence: 300M+ sites, press releases and a money-back guarantee.

mobile.evidence: Phone captures exist for home and pricing but were not assessed.

states.evidence: No error or empty states reached.

value_prop_clarity.evidence: 'Create your future on the leading website builder' is broad but the AI-builder subhead is clear.

proof_quality.evidence: Scale numbers have no source on the page.

persuasion_integrity.evidence: Free plan and a 14-day money-back guarantee are stated plainly, with yearly billing noted.

cta_logic.evidence: 'Start for free' and 'Get Started' are one consistent action.

company_narrative.evidence: The AI-native builder story runs from homepage to Studio Two in the newsroom.

offer_packaging.evidence: Six plans with a recommended tag and a compare link; plan names and tiers are many.

offer_architecture.evidence: A free entry, a guarantee, a reversed price order, a free domain and a services marketplace.

merchant_merch_tools.evidence: Tiered ecommerce and marketing suites, scheduling, payments, POS with synced inventory and business email.

visual_craft.evidence: Clear, airy hierarchy; the home page is very long.

system_coherence.evidence: One display family and blue accent across home, pricing and sign-up.

merchant_design_control.evidence: 2,000+ templates, an AI builder, drag-and-drop editing and no-code design features.

read.summary: A broad, AI-forward website builder with a free start, a guarantee and a clearly anchored plan page. The pricing and sign-up are easy; the proof is scale numbers with no source, and the home page is very long.
pros: A free plan, no credit card and a 14-day money-back guarantee.
Plan page shows prices, storage and commerce tiers side by side.
Sign-up offers Google, Facebook, Apple or email on one screen.
One typeface and blue accent run across pages.
cons: Prices are yearly-in-full; monthly prices were not shown as text.
The home page is 17,325px tall with 19 videos.
read.howItSells: Sells ease and breadth: an AI builder, a free start and a guarantee, then a ladder that moves merchants toward commerce and marketing suites.
copy: Order plans from highest to lowest price.
Offer a money-back guarantee beside the free plan.
Offer social sign-in with email on one screen.
avoid: A very long, media-heavy home page.
unknowns: What the first-time editor experience is.

hypothesis.statement: Showing monthly and yearly prices together on each plan card will lift paid conversion by reducing surprise at checkout.
hypothesis.decisionRule: Ship if conversion rises by a pre-agreed margin and refund rate does not rise over four weeks.

merchandising.summary: A well-anchored free-to-premium ladder with broad merchant tools.
pros: A free plan plus a money-back guarantee.
Highest-priced plan shown first as an anchor.

design.summary: Consistent and approachable across pages, with a very long home page.
pros: Airy layout, rounded type and soft gradients feel friendly.
Blue pill buttons are easy to find.

claims.text: Start for free. No credit card required.
Displayed prices are for yearly subscriptions, paid in full at the time of purchase.
